About.title: {name} — about the shelter
About.descriptionFallback: Contacts and information about the “{name}” shelter.
About.phoneNote: This number is for calls and for Viber messages.
About.joinAdoptText: For an animal waiting in a pen, your home is a whole world. We will tell you about each animal's character and help you prepare for the meeting.
About.joinHelpText: Some need treatment, some need a warm enclosure for winter, and some need a bag of food. Take a look at the <needs>list of needs</needs>, the <treatment>treatment</treatment> section and the shelter's <projects>projects</projects>: any help, big or small, reaches the animals.
About.joinVolunteerText: The shelter needs more than food and treatment: it needs hands. Feeding and caring for the animals, walking dogs, cleaning enclosures: for the animals it is a day when someone took care of them.
About.joinDefault: Call or write to us: together we can help even more animals.

Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.description: What data we collect, why, and how you can control it, in plain words.
Privacy.heading: Privacy policy
Privacy.intro: We collect as little data as we can and explain in plain words what and why.
Privacy.draftNotice: This page is still being prepared: the operator, the contact for requests and the retention periods will be added before the site launches.

data.heading: What data we collect
data.text:
Visitors do not need an account, and we do not ask them for any data. For shelter volunteers we keep only an email address, a role and the shelter's name: we need them to run the shelter's work together.
Server logs may contain a visitor's IP address, which is also personal data. We keep them for a limited time. Before animal photos are published, their metadata, including where they were taken, is removed.

cookies.heading: Cookies
cookies.text: We use only the cookies the site needs to work, for example for volunteer sign-in. There is no analytics and there are no advertising trackers, so no consent banner is needed.

recipients.heading: Who else receives data
recipients.text: The site runs on Vercel (the application) and Supabase (database, sign-in and files). The database is in the European Union, in Frankfurt. Both companies are American, so their data-processing terms and any transfer outside the EU are still being checked; the result will appear here. If other services are connected, for example error tracking, we will add them to this list.

operator.heading: Who is responsible for the data
operator.text: The operator and the contact for requests will be added here before the site launches.

retention.heading: How long we keep data
retention.text: Retention periods for each kind of data will be added here before the site launches. A volunteer's account is deleted on request or when the person leaves the shelter.

rights.heading: Your rights
rights.text:
You can find out what data we hold about you, correct it, delete it, restrict its processing, get a copy, or object to its processing. We answer within a month. Requests are sent by email to the operator; the address will appear here.
If you believe your rights have been violated, you can complain to the National Centre for Personal Data Protection of Moldova.
